leaks.title: Four leaks draining your maintenance company
leaks.sub: None of them is a refrigerant problem. They're operations problems, and each one has a clear fix.

items.pain: Contract visits live in a notebook, and you remember them when an angry customer calls in the middle of summer.
items.fix: Every contract schedules its own visits: two weeks ahead the job is created automatically and the customer gets a WhatsApp reminder.

items.pain: Technicians collect cash, invoices are on paper, and the numbers don't match at month end.
items.fix: Every job ends in an invoice priced from your list, paid in cash or by mada / Apple Pay link, with unpaid totals in front of you.

items.pain: E-invoicing Wave 25 covers every business with revenue above SAR 187,500 in any year from 2022 to 2025, with an integration deadline of 1 February 2027. Excel invoices won't cut it.
items.fix: Simplified and standard tax invoices with 15% VAT, a QR code and sequential numbers from day one, with your data organised for Fatoora integration.

items.pain: Twenty WhatsApp groups, and customers calling every hour: “where's the technician?”
items.fix: One timeline per job. The customer gets the confirmation, then “technician on the way” with a tracking link, then the invoice. All automatic.

items.a: Dawra issues simplified and standard tax invoices with 15% VAT, a QR code and sequential numbers, per the Phase 1 (generation) requirements. Phase 2, integration with the Fatoora platform, is rolled out in waves; Wave 25's deadline is 1 February 2027 for businesses whose revenue exceeded SAR 187,500 in any year from 2022 to 2025. Fatoora integration is in development at Dawra, and we'll announce its date to customers before launch.

The hosting region is configurable to your company's needs. We follow practices aligned with the Saudi Personal Data Protection Law: encrypted connections, role-based access (owner, dispatcher, technician), full isolation of each company's data, and deletion on request. We don't advertise certifications we haven't obtained yet.

items.q: Do I need a dedicated WhatsApp number?
items.a: You can start without one: every message is logged and you can see its text. When you're ready, we connect your company number to the WhatsApp Business Platform and messages go out in your name.

items.q: Our technicians have basic phones. Will it work?
items.a: Yes. The technician app is a light web app that opens in the browser and installs on the home screen. It runs on any Android or iPhone, and photos are compressed before upload for weak rooftop signal.

items.q: What happens when the trial ends?
items.a: Pick a plan and carry on with your data as it is. If you don't pick one, your account and data stay saved and we remind you before anything is paused.

items.q: Is there a contract or commitment?
items.a: No. Billing is monthly and you can cancel any time. Yearly billing is optional and gives you two months free.

final.title: Next summer, let the contracts remind you.
final.sub: Start today, and within a week your whole team is on Dawra.
